target.title: fix(gateway): wrap live-probe JSON.parse calls in try/catch
target.body:
## Summary

Wrap two JSON.parse sites in live-probe helpers in try/catch: MCP loopback JSON-RPC response and cron probe argsJson. Both now produce descriptive errors instead of raw SyntaxError crashes.

## Real behavior proof (required for external PRs)

**Behavior addressed**: Two JSON.parse calls on potentially malformed input without error handling.

**Real environment tested**: Linux, Node 22, OpenClaw main

**Proof script output** (proof-live-probe-json-parse.mts):
```
=== Proof: live-probe helpers JSON.parse hardening ===

--- Test 1: malformed MCP loopback response ---
BEFORE (bare JSON.parse):
  Raw SyntaxError — no context, hard to identify the failing endpoint
AFTER (try/catch with label):
  Error: mcp loopback returned malformed JSON
  Clear context — immediately identifies MCP loopback as source

--- Test 2: malformed cron probe argsJson ---
BEFORE (bare JSON.parse):
  Raw SyntaxError — no context, hard to identify the failing cron job
AFTER (parseCronProbeArgs helper):
  Error: cron probe argsJson is not valid JSON
  Clear context — immediately identifies cron argsJson as source

PASS: both JSON.parse sites now produce descriptive errors.
```

**Tests**:
```
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/gateway-cli-backend.live-probe-helpers.test.ts

 Test Files  3 passed (3)
      Tests  9 passed (9)
```

**What was not tested**: Live MCP server returning malformed JSON.

## Risk

Low. Diagnostic/probe code, not hot-path. Errors rethrown with context.
